entities.summary: Christian Bommelund Christensen is a Danish futsal player and footballer who plays as a midfielder for JB Futsal Gentofte, the futsal division of Jægersborg Boldklub. In September 2018, he made his debut for the Denmark national football team, as the regular squad withdrew following a players' union dispute.
